name: Butterfly Stretch
steps: Sit tall on the floor, bring the soles of your feet together, and let your knees drop comfortably out to the sides.
Hold your ankles or feet lightly and draw your heels as close to your pelvis as feels comfortable.
Keep your spine long and hinge gently forward from your hips until you feel a clear stretch along your inner thighs.
Hold the stretch steadily while breathing slowly, then sit back upright gently and draw your knees together.
tips: Let your knees relax downward naturally rather than bouncing or pushing them down forcefully.
Sit on a folded towel if your lower back rounds heavily in the seated position.
